verdict.rationale: Linear documents its own Figma integration that lets designers create and link issues directly from Figma, so some work tracking can happen inside the design tool without switching apps. Nothing shows that issue or project status can be changed or kept current from Figma. Missing for 10: documented ability to update issue/project status from within Figma, evidence of two-way status sync, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Figma integration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps

citations.quote: Create and link issues directly from Figma
